answer: Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. The reveal must open the same falcon hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the atlas gate. Copying becomes a race the hostile operator always loses, and producing 95 original texts is the only way to fill 40 aliases; the mesa log preserves both halves. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
